name: io.github.tonyyang0504/sunsky-mcp
description: SUNSKY (Shenzhen wholesaler with EU/HK/US overseas warehouses) + SUNSKY Open API (ecommerce supplier

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SUNSKY_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SUNSKY Open API key, issued by your SUNSKY sales manager (https://doc.sunsky-online.com/).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SUNSKY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: SUNSKY Open API secret issued with the key; signs every call (MD5 of the parameter values sorted by name, then '@' + secret) and is never sent.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SUNSKY_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Product text language code (Appendix E), e.g. en, fr, de, es, it, zh_CN; default en.
